definitions.gloss: to advance; to move forward; to make progress
definitions.explanation: To move forward physically, or to make progress toward a goal. Used for both literal movement and figurative advancement of plans, negotiations, or projects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{前進|ぜんしん}した。
⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧{前進|ぜんしん}した。
examples.english: The negotiations moved one step forward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{前進|ぜんしん}した。
examples.english: Overcoming difficulties, the plan made great progress.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for both physical forward movement (troops, vehicles) and figurative progress (negotiations, research, plans). Often appears in news and formal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧{前進|ぜんしん}する (to take one step forward)
- ⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{前進|ぜんしん}する (to make great progress)
- ⟦{着実|ちゃくじつ}→着実：07989_chakujitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{前進|ぜんしん}する (to advance steadily)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to advance, to go forward — general-purpose verb for moving ahead
- ⟦{後退|こうたい}する→後退する：17340_koutaisuru⟧: to retreat, to recede — the opposite of {前進|ぜんしん}する
